About Me

Designing What I Dream,
Building What I Love

My name is Michael William Pizarro Oquendo. I was born in Bayamon, Puerto Rico. I was born to a father who gave me a love for all things construction and design. I spent a lot of time watching and learning how the construction process was done at a young age, as my dad ran his construction business in Puerto Rico.

After moving to Massachusetts, I was exposed to new kinds of architectural styles that I drew constantly. As I grew up, I got into graphic design and architectural design. Now I'm mixing my love for Architecture and Construction through custom home plans, residential renovations, and BIM project management.

I'm always eager to make things more efficient and to put my own special touch on everything I do. Making my dreams a reality and building what I love.
